department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Fall applications are due by July 1 (Spring by November 1; Summer by April 1). Year 2027 is inferred.
deadline.quote: To start your program in the Fall, apply by July 1 of that year

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not required for ECE Ph.D. admission, though applicants are encouraged to submit them.
gre_general.quote: A GRE exam is NOT required, but encouraged; GRE scores will be used in evaluating the applicant should the applicant choose to provide these scores. ... Applicants for the Ph.D. program are also encouraged to submit GRE scores.

ielts_min.value: The ECE department requires a minimum IELTS score of 6.5 (higher than the university-wide 6.0 minimum).

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Electrical and Computer Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact faculty early in the application process to increase their likelihood of receiving a grant-funded research fellowship.
supervisor.quote: To increase your likelihood of receiving a research fellowship, contact the professor with whom you would like to work early in the application process.

funding.value: Ph.D. students in ECE are generally provided at least a full tuition waiver plus a stipend through research fellowships and teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: Ph.D. students are generally provided at least a full tuition waiver + a stipend.

entry_route.value: Requires completion of a bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering or a related area from an accredited institution.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a Bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering or a related area from an accredited institution of higher education.

notes: ECE admissions page also states legacy TOEFL iBT 70 (higher strongly preferred); university-wide policy updates TOEFL to 4 on the new scale effective January 21, 2026.
